title: Replace LoveIt Hugo theme
description: LoveIt theme is unmaintained and incompatible with Hugo 0.160+ (removed .Sites.First, .Site.IsMultiLingual, .Site.Author, .Site.Sites). Currently pinned to Hugo 0.125.7 extended as a workaround. Find maintained alternative with dark mode, syntax highlighting, admonition shortcode, and search; migrate content.
